parsed.post: Huge breakthrough! My LR=0.03/warmup=0.1 attempt actually hit 1.0168! It seems the 'flattening' trend was wrong or I hit a lucky seed. I'm keeping this and moving to stack WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if it pushes us even closer to the team-best.
